label: Foundations of kidney science
description: General nephrology learning in foundations of kidney science. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Relate filtration and tubular transport to clinical measurements.
Explain how muscle mass and non-GFR determinants affect creatinine.

label: Clinical assessment and diagnostics
description: General nephrology learning in clinical assessment and diagnostics. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Combine chronology, urine findings and imaging to frame a kidney problem.
Choose a confirmatory test and explain what its result can and cannot establish.

label: Sodium, water and volume
description: General nephrology learning in sodium, water and volume. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Classify hyponatremia using tonicity and urine measurements.
Prioritize symptoms and control correction while treating a water or volume disorder.

label: Potassium and acid-base
description: General nephrology learning in potassium and acid-base. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Separate cardiac protection, potassium redistribution and potassium removal.
Evaluate CKD acidosis and monitor the effects of its treatment.

label: Mineral metabolism and bone
description: General nephrology learning in mineral metabolism and bone. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Interpret calcium, phosphate and PTH trends together.
Choose a CKD-MBD intervention with attention to dialysis status and treatment harms.

label: Acute kidney injury and acute kidney disease
description: General nephrology learning in acute kidney injury and acute kidney disease. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Recognize and stage AKI from creatinine and urine-output changes.
Treat reversible causes, recognize urgent KRT needs and plan recovery follow-up.

label: Critical care nephrology
description: General nephrology learning in critical care nephrology. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Identify kidney-related disturbances requiring immediate monitored treatment.
Select kidney support in the context of circulation, organ failure and treatment goals.

label: Chronic kidney disease
description: General nephrology learning in chronic kidney disease. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Establish CKD chronicity and classify cause, GFR and albuminuria.
Use progression risk and kidney-protective therapy to plan longitudinal care.
Investigate anemia in CKD rather than assuming erythropoietin deficiency.
Individualize ESA treatment goals while avoiding excessive hemoglobin targets.

label: Hypertension and vascular kidney disease
description: General nephrology learning in hypertension and vascular kidney disease. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Interpret standardized and out-of-office blood pressure measurements.
Individualize blood pressure treatment using symptoms, tolerance and comorbidity.

label: Glomerular diseases
description: General nephrology learning in glomerular diseases. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Integrate nephrotic or nephritic findings, serology and biopsy indications.
Distinguish disease-specific treatment from supportive care and prevent treatment harms.

label: Tubular and interstitial disease
description: General nephrology learning in tubular and interstitial disease. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Use urine and electrolyte findings to localize a tubular defect.
Evaluate drug-related interstitial injury and assess alternatives to continued exposure.

label: Cystic and inherited kidney disease
description: General nephrology learning in cystic and inherited kidney disease. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Assess ADPKD progression risk and discuss familial testing implications.
Explain eligibility, adverse effects and monitoring of a disease-modifying treatment.

label: Stones and obstruction
description: General nephrology learning in stones and obstruction. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Recognize an obstructed or infected urinary tract requiring urgent evaluation.
Connect stone composition and metabolic assessment to recurrence prevention.

label: Diabetes and metabolic kidney disease
description: General nephrology learning in diabetes and metabolic kidney disease. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Select kidney-protective and glucose-lowering treatments within kidney-function limits.
Monitor treatment effects and adjust therapy during acute illness or fasting.

label: Thrombotic microangiopathy and complement
description: General nephrology learning in thrombotic microangiopathy and complement. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Integrate hemolysis, platelet count and kidney injury to recognize TMA.
Distinguish urgent diagnostic pathways and explain when complement evaluation is relevant.

label: Kidney disease in systemic illness
description: General nephrology learning in kidney disease in systemic illness. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Recognize organ-threatening vasculitis and lupus-related kidney disease.
Balance timely tissue diagnosis with the urgency of treating systemic disease.

label: Infection in nephrology
description: General nephrology learning in infection in nephrology. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Assess infection risks before kidney replacement or immunosuppression.
Explain prevention, vaccination and evidence-based evaluation of a suspected infection.

label: Onconephrology and paraproteins
description: General nephrology learning in onconephrology and paraproteins. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Connect malignancy, monoclonal proteins and cancer treatment to kidney injury.
Select appropriate hematologic and kidney investigations without attributing every AKI to cancer.

label: Medicines and nephrotoxicity
description: General nephrology learning in medicines and nephrotoxicity. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Review kidney-function-dependent benefits, risks and interactions of prescribed drugs.
Document monitoring and a restart plan when temporarily interrupting treatment.

label: Dialysis and kidney failure therapies
description: General nephrology learning in dialysis and kidney failure therapies. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Recognize clinical indications for dialysis without relying on a GFR cutoff alone.
Plan modality, access and ongoing dialysis care with the person's preferences.

label: Kidney transplantation
description: General nephrology learning in kidney transplantation. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Plan timely transplant assessment and discuss preemptive transplantation.
Assess candidate risks and infection-prevention needs before transplantation.

label: Procedures and interventional nephrology
description: General nephrology learning in procedures and interventional nephrology. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Explain the diagnostic value and limitations of kidney biopsy.
Plan an intervention with attention to bleeding, infection and access complications.

label: Extracorporeal therapies and apheresis
description: General nephrology learning in extracorporeal therapies and apheresis. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Explain solute clearance, fluid removal and modality constraints.
Evaluate an apheresis indication against disease-specific evidence and treatment risk.
Explain regional citrate anticoagulation, calcium and acid-base monitoring, and dependence on a validated circuit protocol.

label: Life-course and special populations
description: General nephrology learning in life-course and special populations. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Adapt kidney assessment to age, pregnancy, frailty and developmental context.
Explain population-specific treatment tradeoffs and transitions in care.

label: Nutrition, prevention and rehabilitation
description: General nephrology learning in nutrition, prevention and rehabilitation. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Tailor nutrition and activity advice to CKD stage and nutritional stability.
Balance dietary restriction with function, growth and malnutrition risk.

label: Supportive care, ethics and evidence
description: General nephrology learning in supportive care, ethics and evidence. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Discuss conservative kidney care and advance care planning using the person's goals.
Distinguish a graded recommendation from a practice point and identify evidence limits.

label: Kidney interfaces with other specialties
description: General nephrology learning in kidney interfaces with other specialties. Item coverage is reported separately.

objectives.text: Relate kidney findings to cardiac, endocrine and intensive-care problems.
Coordinate a shared care plan and specify which uncertainty requires another specialty.
